title: Think Tank Convergence: Optimal Team Structure & Operations
methodology: Cross-analysis of 30 team session logs, 155 stress tests, coordination benchmarks across 50 agents and 32 threads, historical productivity data, and infrastructure weak link mapping.
data_sources: team_analyzer.py: 20 teams with structured performance data

finding_1_team_sizing.title: Empirical Team Size Optimization
finding_1_team_sizing.verdict: 5-8 agents is the sweet spot. Solo for research. Never 15+ without justification.

evidence.power_law: E = 4.0 * N^(-0.75). Every doubling reduces per-agent output 40-50%.
evidence.note: Infrastructure overhead is <1% regardless of size. The real overhead is cognitive: context-switching, communication, and duplication.

finding_2_cooperation_patterns.title: Cooperation Pattern Effectiveness Ranking
finding_2_cooperation_patterns.verdict: parallel-test > solo > small-parallel > lead-sub. Pipeline and wave-sequential are worst.
finding_2_cooperation_patterns.key_insight: Patterns that maximize parallelism and minimize inter-agent communication win. Pipeline and sequential patterns lose because they serialize work.

finding_3_weak_links.title: Infrastructure Weak Links & Scaling Limits
finding_3_weak_links.verdict: SQLite contention is the primary scaling bottleneck. Rate limiter is broken. Bus needs compaction.
finding_3_weak_links.contention_analysis: Ops/sec drops from 3230 (1 thread) to 126 (32 threads) - a 96% reduction. p99 latency spikes to 230ms at 32 threads. SQLite WAL handles median operations fine (0.2ms) but tail latency explodes under contention.

weak_link_priority.detail: 64.6% denial rate, 79.1% throughput collapse at production load
p99 latency >100ms at 16+ threads. Scale limit ~15 concurrent writers.
No timeout-based reclaim. Can silently deadlock pipelines.
JSONL files grow unbounded. 318 bytes/datapoint at production rate.
Bus offsets lost on restart. Causes message re-processing.
No automatic TTL enforcement. Disk accumulation over time.

finding_4_real_use_cases.title: Stress Test Results for Real Use Cases
finding_4_real_use_cases.verdict: All coordination primitives are production-ready for up to 10 teams. Hub is fastest, help protocol has race safety, work stealing prevents double-claims.

benchmark_highlights.hub_status_updates: 50 agents x 1 update in <25ms total. Mean 0.4ms/update.
benchmark_highlights.help_offer_race_5_threads: 5 teams competing for same request: exactly 1 winner, 0 double-claims.
benchmark_highlights.work_stealing_thundering_herd: 10 threads stealing 50 items: total_stolen <= 50, no double-steal.

finding_5_token_efficiency.title: Token-Efficient I/O Impact on Team Productivity
finding_5_token_efficiency.verdict: 90.2% average token reduction. Enables 11.7x more operations per context window.

impact_on_team_operations.before: Agent reads full index.json (6093 tokens) to find one entry. 96.7% waste.
impact_on_team_operations.after: Agent uses query_kb (123 tokens) for same result. 98% savings.
impact_on_team_operations.net_effect: An agent that previously could do ~16 index reads per context window can now do ~190. This fundamentally changes what's achievable per agent session.

operational_plan.title: Recommended Team Structure & Execution Plan

tier_1_solo_researchers.role: Deep research, API exploration, architecture analysis
tier_1_solo_researchers.coordination: Report to coordinator via AgentReporter only

tier_2_build_teams.role: Tool building, feature implementation, bug fixes
tier_2_build_teams.coordination: Shared WorkStealing queue, direct channels between teams

coordinator.role: Orchestration, think tank convergence, phase transitions

execution_phases.name: Build & Implement
execution_phases.teams: Tier 2 (build teams) + remaining Tier 1 assist via help protocol

execution_phases.name: Test & Validate
execution_phases.deliverables: Test suites, stress tests, validation reports

execution_phases.name: Convergence
execution_phases.deliverables: Think tank report, KB entries, session log

scaling_rules: Use work stealing when >2 teams to prevent idle time.
Enable progress broadcasting at >5 total agents.
Use direct channels (not broadcast) for team-to-team coordination.
Run think tank convergence after each phase, not just at end.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: DO NOT use 15+ agents without unique capability per agent.
DO NOT use wave-sequential execution (introduces idle time).
DO NOT pipeline tasks that can be parallelized.
DO NOT share a single SQLite DB across >15 writer threads.
DO NOT skip progress broadcasting with >5 agents.
DO NOT run competitive teams for engineering work (high duplication).
prerequisites_before_scaling: Fix rate limiter (CRITICAL: 64.6% denial rate blocks production use).
Add zombie work item reclaim (timeout-based, default 30min).
Implement bus file rotation (>1MB trigger compaction).
Persist bus read offsets to SQLite (survive restarts).
Increase _MAX_RETRIES from 5 to 10 for >16 concurrent writers.
